title: Imagine Children's Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Imagine Children’s Museum welcomes all children and their adults, of all abilities, ages, ethnicities, genders, immigration statuses, races, religions, sexual orientations, and socioeconomic statuses. We are committed to ensuring all guests have a positive and safe experience. We expect our staff and guests to act responsibly, and be kind and considerate of others as we share this space. Children visiting Imagine Children’s Museum must be accompanied by an adult who is 18 years or older. Adults are responsible for supervising the children in their group at all times. services.name: Drop-in Programs
services.desc: There is always something new to discover at Imagine! Our pop-up programs bring art, science, movement, engineering, and guided play into your Museum visit. Programs are offered on select days and are included with Museum admission unless otherwise noted. Move, balance, and build confidence during a mini gymnastics experience led by The Little Gym of Everett. Children follow a playful floor course while trying new skills with plenty of encouragement along the way. It is supposed to get a little messy! services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Registration note: Camp registration closes each Friday at noon for camps beginning the following week. If a camp is no longer listed on this page, it is currently full. Thank you for helping us make room on the page for camps that still have openings! Interested in joining a waitlist for a full camp? Please email education@ImagineCM.org with your camper’s name, age, and the camp you are interested in. Need a little more time in your day? Add Extended Play when you register for a full-day camp and enjoy expanded drop-off and pick-up times. Campers can arrive as early as 8:30 a.m. and stay as late as 5:00 p.m. Our team will provide a fun, supervised play experience throughout the Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: As the largest children’s museum in the Pacific Northwest, Imagine Children’s Museum is Washington’s ultimate destination for innovative play and learning! We recently doubled in size, and offer two floors bursting with interactive exhibits specifically designed for children ages 12 and under. Field Trip + Enrichment Most popular! Includes self-guided exploration of the museum PLUS an engaging, hands-on classroom activity led by an Imagine educator. Choose from a variety of STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art, and math) topics. Cost: $15 per student/$11 per adult chaperone.
